description: Change any of: the address (`subdomain`, which stops the old one working at once; ask the user first and show them the full URL), whether a push to a GitHub repository deploys by itself (`deployOnPush`), and which directory holds the application inside the project (`rootDirectory`, null for the whole project). Changing the directory analyzes the project again and reports what it found; the running app changes on the next deploy.

rootDirectory.description: A path like services/api, or null.

subdomain.description: The new address label, like my-app.

name: update_app_settings
title: Change the application's settings
